correction: Inherited generic tie descriptions now explicitly say calibrated score, consistent with the original DS objective.

design.cache: Per-parent exact string cache; identical strings have one model evaluation; logical and unique queries both recorded.
design.candidate_id: SHA256 of strict UTF-8 candidate bytes; no detector-dependent identifier.
design.coverage: Complete word spans within the frozen reference-LM first 4096 token prefix; exact fast-tokenizer offsets, no specials.
design.global_failure: Accept lowest calibrated-score global candidate only if strictly improves prior best; priority breaks score ties.
design.global_origin: Original parent only; every eligible analyzed word; no padding, no operator combinations.
design.greedy_accept: Strictly lower calibrated score; evaluate all applicable unique variants for each word before choosing; stop parent on success.
design.inverse: Exact original strict UTF-8 bytes from verified allowed edit script.
design.objective_justification: D_S uses token-distribution features over sliding reference-LM windows; reversible case probes measure score changes directly, not D_M-B attention/window saliency.
design.padding_failure: Retain lowest-scoring padding candidate for next stage, even if worse than the pre-padding candidate; ties use fixed prefix/suffix order.

design.restarts: Only a documented deterministic full restart before any accepted final generation artifact; no merging partial runs.
design.saliency: baseline calibrated D_S score minus reversible probe calibrated D_S score; descending then original offset; top 8.
design.saliency_probe: Single-span ALT_CASE reversible edit; no deletion or x-occlusion. Cached no-ops are allowed.
design.span_selection: All eligible spans if <=16; otherwise round-half-up evenly spaced indexes i*(N-1)/15 for i=0..15, deduplicate in order.
design.standalone_check: Exclude immediate alphanumeric neighbours; exclude immediate structured-token characters. If empty, use ordinary regex spans.
